text: In Gaussian boson sampling, output probabilities are proportional to |Haf(A_S)|^2, where 'Haf' is the ___, a #P-hard matrix function that counts the perfect matchings of a graph.
explanation: Gaussian boson sampling (Hamilton et al., 2017) replaces the permanent with the Hafnian, which counts perfect matchings and is #P-hard (classical cost ~2^(N/2) in detected photon number N); threshold detectors instead give the Torontonian.
